headline: Power Outage Halts Services On Line 17-Ouro Metro In Sao Paulo
seoTitle: Line 17-Ouro Metro Service Disruption In Sao Paulo
metaDescription: The entirety of the Line 17-Ouro metro system in Sao Paulo has been halted due to a power outage. Replacement bus services are currently being provided.
aiSummaryBullets: Full operations on Line 17-Ouro of the Sao Paulo Metro were suspended Saturday morning.
The disruption was caused by an electrical power failure affecting the line.
Ten free shuttle buses have been deployed to cover the transit route.
aiContextParagraph: On the morning of Saturday, November 28, 2026, the entire Line 17-Ouro of the Sao Paulo Metro system experienced a complete service suspension. According to reports, the interruption began at 6:15 a.m. and is attributed to an electrical power outage. To mitigate the impact on passengers, Metro SP has initiated an emergency response by deploying ten free shuttle buses to serve the affected route throughout the day. This incident follows a period of ongoing infrastructure and operational challenges across various rail and metro lines in the Sao Paulo metropolitan area, which have recently faced multiple technical failures and maintenance-related closures. Public transport authorities have not provided a specific timeline for the full restoration of normal electrical service on the affected Gold Line, but transit operations continue to be managed through alternative bus shuttle services.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent news outlets as part of a recurring series of transit issues across the Sao Paulo metropolitan rail network.
